name: Candy Coated BITEZ Gummies 500mg Baggiez | Delta-9 | Very Berry
description: Very Berry tastes like the berry bowl got raided and rolled through the candy counter. A mashup of juicy berry flavors comes through sweet, tangy, and slightly jammy, with no single berry stealing the spotlight. The outside is packed with tiny, colorful crunchy candies, creating a crisp little crackle before you reach two soft, chewy gummy layers packing 50mg of hemp-derived Delta-9 THC in each gummy underneath.
